It re-establishes negative intrapleural pressure so the lung can re-expand, and is a core acute-medical and surgical skill for pneumothorax, pleural effusion, empyema and haemothorax.

1INDICATIONS & PRINCIPLE

A drain is placed when air or fluid in the pleural space compromises lung expansion or gas exchange, or when the collection must be evacuated to control infection or bleeding. The pleural space is normally a potential space at negative pressure; a collection abolishes this, collapsing the lung.

🫁Pneumothorax
Tension pneumothorax (after needle decompression), or a large/symptomatic or ventilated pneumothorax
💧Pleural effusion
Large or symptomatic effusion, or malignant effusion for drainage ± pleurodesis
🦠Empyema
Pus in the pleural space, or a parapneumonic effusion with pH < 7.2 — needs drainage plus antibiotics
🩸Haemothorax
Blood in the pleural space, commonly traumatic; large-bore drain and monitor output for ongoing bleeding
2INSERTION IN THE SAFE TRIANGLE

Elective drains are inserted into the triangle of safety to avoid major vessels, the internal mammary artery and abdominal organs. Insert just above the rib to avoid the neurovascular bundle that runs under each rib.

Anterior border: lateral edge of pectoralis major.
Posterior border: lateral edge of latissimus dorsi.
Inferior border: a horizontal line at the level of the nipple (roughly 5th intercostal space).
Apex: the axilla. Use ultrasound guidance for fluid; use aseptic technique, local anaesthetic, and blunt dissection (Seldinger for small-bore).

The drain is secured with a suture and dressing, then connected to an underwater seal drainage bottle kept below the level of the chest at all times.

3UNDERWATER SEAL: SWINGING, BUBBLING, DRAINING

The tube end sits under ~2 cm of sterile water, forming a one-way valve. Three observations tell you what the drain is doing:

Swinging (fluid moves up on inspiration, down on expiration)→Tube is patent and in the pleural space; oscillation reflects intrapleural pressure changes
Bubbling through the water→Air is leaving the pleural space — an ongoing air leak (expected in pneumothorax; new bubbling elsewhere suggests a fault)
Draining (volume rising in the bottle)→Fluid, blood or pus is being evacuated; chart the volume and character
Stopped swinging AND not bubbling/draining→Either the lung has fully re-expanded, OR the drain is blocked/kinked/dislodged — check with imaging before assuming success

Suction (low-pressure, e.g. −10 to −20 cmH₂O) may be added on specialist advice for a persistent air leak or failure of the lung to re-expand.

4CLAMPING, REMOVAL & COMPLICATIONS

Clamping is generally avoided. A bubbling (air-leaking) drain must never be clamped, as trapped air can accumulate and produce a tension pneumothorax. Brief clamping is only used in controlled settings (e.g. to check for a re-accumulating effusion before removal, or to change a bottle) with close observation.

Pneumothorax: fully re-expanded, no air leak (stopped bubbling)→Consider removal; remove during expiration or Valsalva to prevent air entry
Effusion: output < ~200 mL/24 h and symptoms resolved→Consider removal; close the pre-placed purse-string / mattress suture

Complications: malposition (subcutaneous, fissure, abdominal), organ injury (lung, heart, liver, spleen), re-expansion pulmonary oedema after rapid drainage of a large collection, infection/empyema, and a blocked, kinked or dislodged drain.

🚩 NEVER clamp a bubbling drain — the escaping air becomes trapped and can cause a tension pneumothorax. If a patient with a chest drain develops sudden breathlessness, hypotension, expanding surgical emphysema (crackling under the skin) or the drain falls out, treat as an emergency: unclamp, apply an occlusive-but-not-airtight dressing to a dislodged site, and seek senior help immediately.
🎓 Learn the difference cold: SWINGING = patency (the tube is open and correctly in the pleural space), BUBBLING = an air leak (air is coming out of the lung/pleura). A drain that swings but does not bubble is patent with no air leak; a drain that neither swings nor bubbles is either done its job or blocked — image before you trust it.
